title: Humble Home Resource Pack
description: Resource pack for Humble Home datapack.
body:
Resource Pack for the [Humble Home](https://modrinth.com/project/humble-home) datapack.

Textures:
- Brick Furnace (overwrites furnace)
- Copper Tools (overwrites stone tools)
- Wooden, Copper, and Iron Shields (does not interfere with default shield)
- Flint Pick & Copper Chisel (custom tools)
